filing_office: Rhode Island Department of State, Business Services Division
filing_fee_notes: Base formation fee; optional services cost extra.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain a resident agent with a physical street address in Rhode Island.
annual_report_due: February 1 through May 1, beginning in the calendar year after registration.
franchise_or_privilege_tax: An annual minimum tax or fee of 400 applies; tax treatment depends on the LLC's classification.
unemployment_insurance_agency: Rhode Island Department of Labor and Training, Employer Tax Division
plain_english_summary: File articles for 150 and submit an annual report for 50. Budget separately for the annual minimum tax or fee.
common_mistake: The annual report does not replace the minimum tax payment.
notes: Ordinary domestic LLC. Online annual-report charges are additional; their total was not confirmed. Formation portal, processing time, expedited service, publication requirement and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
